facts.text: I am looking for ideas for displaying my art pieces.

I like the idea of a shadow box.

I want the background elements to resemble Luna's windowsill.

I am considering whether to place the figurine in the center or off to one side in the shadow box.
I like the idea of creating a diagonal composition.
I want to add a small, curved piece of cardboard or foam board to create a sense of a cat bed or a windowsill in the background.
I will add a curved piece of cardboard to create a sense of a windowsill behind Luna's figurine.
I will choose a scale and shape that fits with the overall composition.
I will add texture and color to give the windowsill a more realistic look.
